<p class="docs-lead">GenoDisc is an open-source Snakemake pipeline for post-GWAS functional genomics. Starting from GWAS summary statistics, it runs a standardised battery of analyses — fine-mapping, gene-level and transcriptome/proteome-wide association, heritability, and drug-target enrichment — to prioritise the genes, mechanisms, and candidate drugs behind an association signal. It also powers the hosted GenoDisc platform at King’s College London; this site documents how to install, configure, and run the pipeline yourself.</p>

<div class="note-box"><p><strong>Just want results?</strong> Use the hosted GenoDisc platform → <a href="https://genodisc.er.kcl.ac.uk">genodisc.er.kcl.ac.uk</a></p></div>

## The hosted platform

Don't want to install anything? Submit your GWAS via the hosted platform — the pipeline runs on King's College London servers and results appear in an interactive viewer, with no local software installation.

<a href="https://genodisc.er.kcl.ac.uk/" class="button">Go to the platform ↗</a>
